categories.name: أَلْفَاظُ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْبَعْثِ
categories.nameEn: Terms for the Hereafter and Resurrection

items.verse: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.

items.verse: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَٱفْتَدَوْا۟ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَحْتَسِبُونَ
items.verseEn: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allāh that which they had not taken into account.

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
items.verseEn: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

categories.name: أَعْلَامُ الأَشْخَاصِ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Famous Individuals Named in the Qur'an

items.verseEn: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
And recite to them the news of Abraham,
The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

items.verse: فَمَآ ءَامَنَ لِمُوسَىٰٓ إِلَّا ذُرِّيَّةٌۭ مِّن قَوْمِهِۦ عَلَىٰ خَوْفٍۢ مِّن فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِمْ أَن يَفْتِنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ لَعَالٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
items.verseEn: But no one believed Moses, except [some] offspring [i.e., youths] among his people, for fear of Pharaoh and his establishment that they would persecute them. And indeed, Pharaoh was haughty within the land, and indeed, he was of the transgressors.

categories.name: أَفْعَالُ الْإِدْرَاكِ الْحِسِّيِّ
categories.nameEn: Verbs of seeing, hearing and blind wandering

items.verseEn: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

items.verse: أَوَلَمْ يَنظُرُوا۟ فِى مَلَكُوتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍۢ وَأَنْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَدِ ٱقْتَرَبَ أَجَلُهُمْ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
items.verseEn: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allāh has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement [i.e., message] hereafter will they believe?

items.verse: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
items.verseEn: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
And the people of the city came rejoicing.

items.verse: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰسِرُونَ
items.verseEn: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allāh - it is those who are the losers.
They will be in gardens, honored.

items.verse: قَالَ ٱجْعَلْنِى عَلَىٰ خَزَآئِنِ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنِّى حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."

harf.hint: A moral burden one seeks forgiveness for
harf.arabicVerse: يُوسُفُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَـٰذَا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرِى لِذَنۢبِكِ ۖ إِنَّكِ كُنتِ مِنَ ٱلْخَاطِـِٔينَ
harf.verse: 12:29 - Joseph, ignore this. And, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful."

deduction.title: The First Blood Spilled in Envy
deduction.intro: Picture the earliest days of humanity, when the whole world was one family. You watch as two offerings are placed before Allah — one accepted, the other rejected. Envy takes root in a heart, and a threat is whispered in anger. What follows will leave a mark on history forever, and even a small bird will become a teacher.
clues: I belong to the very first family on earth.
I presented an offering to Allah, but mine was not accepted while the other offering was.
I spoke out in envy and threatened to take a life.
I committed the first unjust killing on earth.
I saw a crow scratching the ground to show me how to hide a body.
I was left full of regret and became among the losers for what my hands had done.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Qabil (Cain), son of Adam
Samiri, the maker of the calf
Namrud, the tyrant who argued with Ibrahim
Azar, the maker of idols
Kan'an, the drowned son of Nuh

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Murder of a sibling out of envy after rejected offering
Building a lofty tower to look at the heavens
Fashioning a golden calf for worship
Demanding a table spread from heaven
Leading an army of elephants to destroy the Kaaba
trial.answer: Murder of a sibling out of envy after rejected offering

location.label: Key Element
options: A crow scratching the earth to show burial
A golden calf that lowed
A great ark upon the flood waters
A staff that became a serpent
A table spread with food from heaven
location.answer: A crow scratching the earth to show burial

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Became remorseful and among the losers
Was drowned in the great flood
Was swallowed by the earth with treasure
Was struck with leprosy for seven years
Was granted a kingdom with control of the winds
outcome.answer: Became remorseful and among the losers

deduction.arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
deduction.verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)

scramble.hint: Allah's complete knowledge of what hearts hide and what is made open
scramble.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
scramble.verseEn: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

root.meaning: The core idea is keeping something safe from harm or loss. Its words grow by showing a guarding person or a thing kept secure through care.
